Name: Miss Coriel's Combined Music Pack
Author: MissCoriel
Description:
There is currently nothing special about this pack.. I promised I would combine all my music together in one pack for easier Downloading.  
As before, Most songs in Stardew Valley have been replaced with music hailing from various popular RPGs from the SNES age... All handcrafted (not copied) by MissCoriel.  

[b]Installation:[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Ensure  you have [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PYTK[/url] installed
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043]Custom Music[/url]﻿
[*]Download this mod and Place it in the Mods Folder.
[/list]
[size=5][b][size=5]Visit my [/size][url=https://discord.gg/uSGNKNf]Cozy Apartment[/url][size=5] if you have questions or interests.[/size]
[size=3]Have the desire to support me and my endeavors?
[url=https://www.patreon.com/MissCoriel]Support me through Patreon[/url]
My promise to you:  My mods will always be free and open.  Patreon will give you special Discord roles on my server and Exclusive access to my original music.  
You do not need to ever pay money to access my mods/content or beta releases![/size][/b][/size]
